materials.name: fabric
materials.wears: the short-sleeved uniform shirt and the cargo trousers with thigh pockets. The sleeves are short and end three quarters of the way down the upper arm, a hand above the elbow. Plain trousers waistband with no belt, shirt tucked in. The trouser legs are tucked into the boots.

materials.name: gear
materials.look: WARM TAN, like khaki canvas and tan leather
materials.wears: the soft fabric plate carrier vest, the row of pouches across the stomach, the short tactical gloves, and the lace-up combat boots, which are tan suede with tan soles and tan laces and end a hand above the ankle. The gloves are tan all over, close-fitting, and end at the wrist in a plain narrow hem: no cuff, nothing on the forearm. The vest is soft fabric, the same tan as the pouches; its two shoulder straps lie close to the collar, well inside the sleeve seams; it is narrow at the sides and ends well short of the armpits, with no pouches on its sides. Also tan: the two straps that hold each shin guard on. Each one is a broad flat band of tan webbing that goes right round the shin, the same tan as the vest, with a plain tan buckle. No strap is grey, blue or dark. Nothing in the outfit is black or dark.

materials.name: plates
materials.look: BRIGHT LIGHT SKY BLUE hard plastic, a saturated baby blue (hex #78AAE6), clearly coloured and as light as the tan
materials.wears: the rigid knee pads and shin guards, and nothing else. Each knee pad is one rounded shell centred on the knee, fixed to the trouser leg with no strap. Each shin guard is one long shell on the front of the shin: it starts below the knee pad, with a clear band of grey cloth showing between the two, and ends above the top of the boot. Every guard and pad is plainly sky blue, with no grey in it: not a pale blue-grey, and not a dark or royal blue. Only the hard shells are blue; the straps that hold the shin guards on are tan. Nothing above the knees is blue: there are no shoulder, arm or chest plates.

prompt:
Product image of one security uniform for a near-future corporate facility guard, standing in an A-pose. Show the clothing and gear only, as an empty outfit on an invisible mannequin: headless, with invisible arms. The collar is an empty opening, each short sleeve ends in an empty opening, and there is nothing inside the outfit. No arms and no skin anywhere in the image: the two gloves hang in the air where the hands would be.

Pose, the most important thing in this image: a strict A-pose, like a 3D character model sheet. The two short sleeves are straight tubes that point sideways and downward, each one 45 degrees away from the body, exactly as they would sit on straight arms lifted sideways. Each sleeve ends three quarters of the way from the shoulder to the elbow, a hand above the elbow, in a straight clean hem. Each glove floats where the hand of that straight arm would be: on the same straight line as its sleeve, far out to the side at hip height, well away from the thigh, open and flat with the fingers together, pointing along that line. Between the hem of a sleeve and its glove there is only white background, a gap as long as the sleeve and the glove together. Between each sleeve and the torso there is an empty wedge of white background that starts right at the armpit. The sleeves do not touch the vest anywhere, and the whole underside of each sleeve from armpit to hem is visible against white. Legs straight, feet shoulder width apart, a clear gap between the legs all the way up.

{materials}
The grey cloth is clearly greyer and darker than the tan gear, and the tan gear is clearly browner than the cloth. The blue plates are clearly bluer and lighter than the grey cloth, which has no blue in it. Every part of the outfit is one of these three colours and nothing is in between: a strap is tan, never a grey-blue.

{construction}

Smooth clean surfaces like a painted sculpt: plain colour on every part, clean and new with no dirt or wear, matte plastic, smooth cloth with only large soft folds, simple chunky shapes, clean edges between parts.

Camera: straight front view, camera level with the chest, long lens with almost no perspective. The outfit stands upright and symmetrical.

Soft even studio lighting with gentle shading that shows the forms, the whole outfit in frame from collar to boot soles and from glove to glove with margin on all sides, plain white background.
